Name: CSS' Anniversary Celebrations
Author: ClairesStoryofSeasons
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/wInB02W.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AGODqEo.png[/img][/center]
[quote][color=#ffe599][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Anniversary Celebrations is a mod that lets your farmer experience an annual wedding anniversary dinner date with your vanilla (non-modded) spouse. The event is tied to your wedding date anniversary and will become available again on future anniversaries (as long as the conditions are met). I highly recommend that you use this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8351?tab=description]Anniversary on Calendar[/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/1LaUN2e.png[/img] for ease of tracking. This mod may be installed mid-save.[/font][/size][/color][/quote]
[list]
[*][b][i]How to trigger this mod's content? --[/i][/b] First and foremost, you [u]must[/u] have a [color=#ffffff][b]good relationship with your spouse (12 hearts and up or 3000 Friendship Points) [/b]to trigger this mod. On the day of your weddi[/color]ng anniversary, your spouse will send you an invitation through the mail. [u]Reading the invitation is a precondition for triggering the event[/u]. [b]Once read, [/b]enter the Saloon on the evening [u][b](5-9 PM)[/b][/u] and enjoy a special night in with your spouse. 
[font=Trebuchet MS]⤷ Note: To trigger the dialogue the day/a few days after the event, make sure to KISS your spouse on the date of your anniversary. [/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][i][b]How many events are in this mod? [/b][/i]-- Three for each of the 12 vanilla candidates. This mod offers unique dialogue for each spouse during the anniversary dinner, as well as a unique post-date event the first time you trigger this mod's content. During subsequent anniversaries, a separate event will play which will repeat every year. All of the events require that you have a good relationship with your spouse.[/*]
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/f4wjXpQ.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][/left]
[left]Download the ZIP file and extract its contents into your Mods folder. Manual installation of this mod is recommended. Make sure all required files are installed. Anniversary Celebrations require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.9.0[/url] or higher versions and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Actions (BETAS)[/url]. For other issues, include your SMAPI log (and any relevant information) so that I may know how to address your problem.[/left]


[center] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Cvnl8ns.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[quote][b][i][color=#fce5cd][font=Trebuchet MS]1) Is this compatible with [url=https://www.google.com/search?q=sve+stardew&oq=&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUqBggAEEUYOzIGCAAQRRg7MgwIARAAGEMYgAQYigUyDQgCEAAYkQIYgAQYigUyDAgDEAAYQxiABBiKBTIMCAQQABhDGIAEGIoFMgcIBRAAGIAEMgcIBhAAGIAEMgcIBxAAGIAEMgcICBAAGIAEMgcICRAAGI8C0gEHODYwajBqOagCBrACAfEFR__LQuwliio&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]? -- Yes. This mod accounts for SVE's map changes.

2) Okay, but what about modded spouses? -- Nope, sorry. This mod only offers events for the 12 vanilla marriage candidates (i.e., Sebastian, Elliott, Shane, Harvey, Sam, Alex, Abigail, Leah, Emily, Maru, Penny, and Haley).  I might write one for Krobus on a future update.

2.1) Okay, but... why not? -- I prefer to leave marriage content for modded NPCs in the hands and within the creative agency of their respective mod authors. Requests to make an event for a modded NPC will [u]not[/u] be entertained.

3) Can I use this mod when I have multiple spouses (i.e., Free Love)? -- It should work. As for Free Love, if you have multiple spouses, [u]change your main spouse to the given NPC a day before your anniversary[/u] to trigger the event. 

4) This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Kantrip's Wedding Anniversaries[/url]. [img]https://i.imgur.com/1LaUN2e.png[/img]

5) Why is my spouse standing up during the dinner date? -- Besides Alex, they don't have sitting sprites.
Bear with me.  (ᵕ•᷄ ᴗ•᷅ )

6) Is this compatible with Multiplayer? -- I have not tested MP support but theoretically, it should. Do let me know if there are any issues in MP that I need to be aware of.[/font][/color][/i][/b][/quote]
